title: Optimized for fun
description: Small pack of mods that makes the game a bit better
body:
# 🚀 Optimized for Fun

**Optimized for Fun** is a lightweight, performance-focused modpack for **Fabric 1.21.1**. It is designed to bridge the gap between a pure vanilla experience and a modern, high-performance setup by adding essential Quality-of-Life (QoL) features and atmospheric enhancements.

---

## ✨ Key Features

* **⚡ Extreme Performance:** Includes cutting-edge optimization mods like **Bobby**, allowing you to see further with better frame rates than vanilla.
* **🌿 Immersive Atmosphere:** Features **Ambient Environment** and **Cold Breath** to make the world feel alive and reactive to your surroundings.
* **🛠️ Quality of Life:** Streamline your gameplay with **AppleSkin** (hunger/saturation info), **Client Sort** (inventory organization), and **Better Statistics Screen**.
* **🎨 Visual Polish:** Comes pre-loaded with **Golden-Days** for a crisp, high-definition look that stays true to the original game style. (You can enable the faithful pack within the profiles when under resource packs)
* **💬 Clean UI:** Enhances your interface with **Chat Animations**, **Capes**, and **Boat Item View** for better navigation.

---

## 🛠 Technical Overview

* **Loader:** Fabric
* **Version:** 1.21.1
* **Style:** Vanilla+ / Performance
* **Mod Count:** 90+ Essential Mods

---

## 📦 Why Use This Pack?

Most modpacks add too much "clutter." **Optimized for Fun** focuses strictly on making the game run faster, look better, and play smoother. It is the perfect base for players who want a polished Minecraft experience without changing the core mechanics of the game.
